article.body:
Title: Research Paper Lists Method for Policy Optimization in Adversarial MDPs

The arXiv cs.LG record lists "Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs," identifying a research paper, not a policy decision, procurement action or operational capability. The paper provides no abstract, results or implementation details, so it does not establish which method was developed or whether any organization can use it. The research remains at the stage of a published paper, not yet demonstrated or operational.

The affected organization is the academic and research community, as they are the intended audience for the paper. The paper offers a potential solution for policy optimization in Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), but its practical application and adoption by organizations are not yet established.
